[[File:Shadow warrior icon.png|left]]
A '''Shadow warrior''' is a deceased knight, found in the basement of the [[Legends' Guild]]. They are considered [[undead]], so the [[salve amulet]] has an effect on them. They do not count for the [[Shadow creatures (Slayer assignment)|shadow creature Slayer assignment]].

After completion of [[Legends' Quest]], Shadow warriors are also a [[slayer task]] given by [[Chaeldar]] and [[Mazchna]]. Shadow warriors appear to be wielding [[battleaxe]]s, but they attack at the ''fast'' speed of [[scimitar]]s (2.4 seconds, or 4 ticks).

Shadow warriors do not appear on the minimap.

==Trivia==
* They still use the old [[RuneScape 2]] animations.
* The examine info 'He's a shadow of his former self' is a reference to the [https://www.dictionary.com/browse/shadow-of-one-s-self popular phrase].
